routeros.board_name: CHR QEMU Ubuntu 24.04 PC v2 (i440FX + PIIX, arch_caps fix, 1996)

managed_invalid_rule_classes.routing_marks: both managed mark-routing rules were invalid at runtime

important_observation: RouterOS import dry-run and apply both returned verdict OK, but runtime mangle objects were invalid. Therefore syntax/import success is not sufficient evidence for PCC correctness; runtime invalid-state inspection and dataplane behavior are mandatory gates.

false_green_discovered.root_harness_bug: cleanup() executed set +e and disabled shell errexit for the remainder of the acceptance script, allowing evaluator exit 17 to be masked.
false_green_discovered.harness_fix: cleanup no longer changes errexit; contract tests forbid set +e; prepare now fails closed if any managed PCC mangle rule has invalid=true.

next_gate: Identify the exact RouterOS 7.24.1 runtime requirement causing PCC/mangle objects to become invalid, fix the renderer from observed evidence, then rerun fail-closed CHR packet-flow acceptance until normal 10:1 distribution, WAN10 failure failover, and recovery/failback all PASS.
